dialog: I'm joining the fray.
There's only one thing you need on a battlefield.
I'm after you now. Blame your own misfortune.
With that out of the way/ it's time to show you MY magic.
I'm the last person you'd want to give an opening!
Here just to let me beat you down/ are you?
This is what happens when you pick fights without the strength to back it up.
Let's just end things here/ shall we?
Challenging me? You're a reckless one!
Don't make light of me!
You're up against me? Talk about a stroke of bad luck/ eh?
I will put an end to you!
Bar my way and I'll crush you.
I don't have any time to waste/ you see.
Unfortunately/ I'll have to end things here.
We're on completely different levels/ and you're about to feel it!
I'll send you to the grave right now! Don't test me!
It was a good fight/ but this is where it ends.
You lost because that attack didn't finish me!
That was the only chance you'll ever have!
I never miss!
You should have known better!
Find your way past THIS!
This will hit you!
I see you!
You'll never dodge this!
Energy Shower!
I'll knock you all out of the sky!
Rain down upon them!
You'll be drowned before you know it!
Energy Shower!
This won't even leave a hair behind.
Psycho Blast!
I'll show you magic...
Now get out of here!
I'm not about to show mercy!
Now get out of here!
You picked the wrong opponent.
Take this!
I'll send you to oblivion!
Akashic Record/ unlock!
Watch closely/ for a glance is all you'll get!
Akashic Catastrophe!
Buried souls/ unreaching feelings/ the walls between dimensions...
...and despair!
Your souls are but a few of the many I will bring with me.
Odd that you'd try and make me serious/ but very well!
Akashic Record/ connect!
The highest magic at my command!
Akashic Catastrophe!
Buried souls/ unreaching feelings/ the walls between dimensions...
Know their cruelty!
All shall return to oblivion...
I'll show you what I'm like at my best!
Akashic Record/ load!
Lend me your ears...
Akashic Catastrophe!
Buried souls/ unreaching feelings/ the walls between dimensions...
Listen to the voices from beyond!
For it is all there/ even now...
You won't get off so easy next time.
You're really pushing your luck/ you know that?
Talk about dull.
Those are some good eyes on that one.
I'll pay you back for the both of us!
Yes/ let's combine our strength!
Time for a little exercise!
I'll show you how harsh a battlefield can be!
Hey/ there/ let me have a go!
Whoa/ there. Not so fast.
I'd rather not have to do anything extra/ but I'll make an exception.
You're up against me/ understand?
Create an opening/ then exploit it!
Working with others isn't my style/ but I'll make an exception.
I'll attack first!
Let me see your strength!
I'm right there with you/ so get going.
Yes/ let's combine our strength!
Just think of this as a little distraction!
Yes/ let's finish them off with a blast!
Show me what you look like at full power!
Let's both intend to finish them off!
If they made you that desperate/ then I'll have to intervene!
I'll show you an example/ Marisa.
My pupil always lacks follow-through.
My pupil lets herself be vulnerable too much.
Hey/ dummy/ don't get cocky!
I'll go with you/ Marisa!
I'll force an opening/ Marisa.
Do a good job/ alright/ Marisa?
I'll help you out/ Marisa.
Still a fledgling/ huh?
Show me your magic/ Marisa!
Give it everything you have/ Marisa!
So that's how you do things/ is it/ Marisa?
I'll give them a taste of my magic next/ Marisa!
Leave the rest to me/ Marisa.
You still leave yourself too vulnerable/ Marisa.
Was that just an accident/ Marisa?
I'll head in first with my magic!
I doubt you need much saving at this point/ but still.
I'll go in first/ Marisa.
I want to see your magic.
I'll go in first/ Marisa.
Try and keep up with my magic!
Show me that you can stand at my side!
Let's finish them off with our magic combined!
I'll show you what happens when you pick a fight with a magician.
I'll head in first with my magic!
I want to see your magic.
I'll show you what happens when you pick a fight with a magician.
I want to see your magic.
I'll head in first with my magic!
Whoa/ hang on. What drove you to do THAT?
I pity anyone who has to take on the two of us.
You didn't finish them off/ Yuuka.
You owe me one/ Yuuka.
Would you take this a little more seriously/ Yuuka?
I'll poke them a few times/ Yuuka.
I don't know whether you actually need the help/ but still.
I pity anyone who has to take on the two of us.
Stay sharp or you're gonna get me killed!
I'll go in first/ Yuuka!
If I'm partnered with you anyway/ why don't we make a show of things?
I wonder which of us will land the finishing blow.
Let's both try not to break them too hard.
I already knew you'd do that.
You won't get to me with that.
If I see where you're aiming/ that makes things easy.
We're different/ you and I.
Laughable.
I wish the rabble would get out of the way.
I am far more experienced at battle than you.
Was that supposed to be an attack?
Ugh. If I keep taking hits like this...
I didn't think you'd push me this far...
Don't get cocky!
This can't be a losing battle!
Looks like I'm at a disadvantage here.
You really want me to take this seriously!
Oh. Huh. You're not bad.
You're more trouble than I thought!
If you can hit me/ you're going places.
I can't let some small fries cause me trouble.
Whoops. Couldn't block the whole thing.
I'm still hale and hearty!
I suppose you're not completely helpless.
That was actually quite a strike.
The impudence...
Alright/ fine. I'll take you on.
That wasn't much... But I can't be careless on the battlefield.
I've already figured out that trick.
I have more experience—and it shows.
What/ are you scared of me?
I see right through you.
You're very annoying/ you know that?
This is really all danmaku amounts to.
That was awful. You should start your training from square one.
Alright/ I think I know how strong you are now.
Good attack. Or it would have been/ if it had landed.
Your doubts are clear as day.
This is a magical barrier.
This proves my power stands above yours.
What/ are you done already?
That won't even make me flinch.
I'll cut it down.
If you're not sure/ then I'll make the first move.
That was the wrong time to let your guard down!
I'll show you your place!
I underestimated them...
That was my mistake/ wasn't it...
I don't want to see you cutting any corners while I'm gone/ understand?
Great. Well/ I guess I'm taking a break now.
Looks like you're just as skilled as ever.
You're very sharp/ unlike your master...
Sorry for imposing on you in Makai/ Shinki.
Give me a taste of the power of creation!
I never thought someone like this would be behind everything!
I want to see your guts!
Now this is an interesting enemy!
It would have been more exciting if you were the real deal.
Alright/ let's see what you're made of.
I suppose I could have lived like you/ but I wouldn't have.
This is a good chance to settle our score/ Yuuka!
Alright/ fine. I'll be serious about this!
I want to see your guts!
You could just run away/ you know. I'd let you go.
I can appreciate someone striving for their goals without caring about what others think.
Don't you understand what you're even doing?
I'd rather not rehash old fights/ but alright.
That's a lot of power/ sure/ but how well can you control it?
I'll see your ambitions shattered to pieces!
It seems you have the strength to back up your decision to make an enemy of me!
This isn't like me/ but I'm going to try giving everything I have to help another!
That's a lot of power/ sure/ but how well can you control it?
I'll see your ambitions shattered to pieces!
It seems you have the strength to back up your decision to make an enemy of me!
This isn't like me/ but I'm going to try giving everything I have to help another!
